name: ser-player
tagline: A simple video player for playing SER files used for solar, lunar and planetary astronomy-imaging.
blurb: A simple video player for playing SER files used for solar, lunar and planetary astronomy-imaging.
description:
A simple video player for playing SER files used for solar, lunar and planetary astronomy-imaging.

SER Player is a C++ application using the Qt cross-platform framework so that it can be built for Windows, macOS and Linux.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
